name: Tokeiya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood clock and watch shop: a regular-day-off notice, a first day helping swap a watch band, a seasonal-watch price list with a point-card bonus, a free battery-replacement notice, a new-staff training comparison, a customer-preference listening story, a trainee lesson on taking apart and repairing a watch, an explainer on why a discounted scratched-stock corner started, a seasonal watch-set application guide, a column on how more repair requests changed the shop's day, a busy-season reception rule, a column on the meaning of a clock shop's repair craft, and a one-year parts-wholesaler cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
